# TODO(T-15, #23): monitor.yml now installs via `uv sync --frozen` (hash-
# verified against uv.lock) instead of this file. Kept only as a manual
# pip fallback for environments without uv; no workflow reads it anymore.
# Regenerate after any uv.lock change if you still rely on it, or delete it
# once you're confident nothing outside CI needs the pip path.
#
# This file is generated from uv.lock via:
#    uv export --no-dev --no-hashes --format requirements-txt -o requirements.txt
# then editing the `-e .` line below to `.`, and dropping --hash pins:
# pip's hash-verification mode refuses any local directory source (editable
# or not — "Can't verify hashes for these file:// requirements because they
# point to directories"), which is why it was never hash-verified even when
# monitor.yml did use it. Every third-party dependency below is still pinned
# to the exact version locked in uv.lock.
.
